description: Original public synthetic query corpus. No private user searches. Q20 repeats Q04 as an explicit timing control.

queries.criteria: Recent AI reporting; generic undated topic hubs are partial, not proof of recency.

queries.query: Precio de la electricidad hoy en España
queries.criteria: Spain electricity tariff sources explicitly dated to evaluation day; do not grade claimed prices as factually correct.
Recent small language model research, not education mini-investigations or old AI retrospectives.
Official Foundation Models Swift documentation; generic Foundation pages are partial.
Current mlx-swift-lm release/tag/changelog, not only an undated repository homepage.
Technology reporting related to Valladolid; generic national news is partial, old social video is insufficient.
Explanations of retrieval augmented generation with the retrieval/generation relationship.

queries.query: Modelos de lenguaje locales para iPhone
queries.criteria: Sources explicitly about running language models locally on iPhone.
Swift cooperative cancellation and structured concurrency documentation/examples.
Research about on-device AI with evidence of currentness; market-size forecasts do not satisfy research intent.

queries.query: Museo Nacional de Escultura Valladolid horario
queries.criteria: Official museum visitor hours preferred; conflicting schedules require verification.
An explanation of photosynthesis, energy conversion and its inputs/outputs.
Python 3.15 release notes or official changelog; other versions are partial or irrelevant.
Spanish self-consumption regulation applicable in 2026; primary legal/regulatory sources preferred.
Swift concurrency documentation; record language coverage separately from topical relevance.

queries.criteria: Small language models and quantization in MLX Swift on Apple hardware.
Apple documentation of LanguageModelSession; preserve the supplied site operator.
Only sources matching the exact project plus rare phrase satisfy intent; unrelated Lua Lapis pages are irrelevant. Zero results can be a valid outcome.
History or heritage of the named municipality; generic province pages are partial.
Repeat of Q04 for timing/order sensitivity, not an independent query in population claims.
Examples explaining actor reentrancy across suspension points.

queries.query: URLSession HTTP2 connection reuse Apple documentation
queries.criteria: Apple networking documentation or concrete technical material on session/connection reuse.

The MIT license permissions and conditions; external service rights remain separate.
Explanations of neural networks, not unrelated neural biology only.

queries.criteria: Distinguish power and energy with units and practical examples.

queries.query: cómo se forma una aurora boreal
queries.criteria: Sources explaining the physical formation of auroras.

queries.criteria: Explanations of blue sky and Rayleigh scattering.
Sources addressing mercury as planet or element; record ambiguity rather than inventing a single intended meaning.
Animal or car meanings are both legitimate; do not penalize ambiguity as parser failure.

Rust ownership/borrowing language concepts, not metal corrosion.
Library opening hours for Valladolid including Sunday; distinguish institutions.

queries.criteria: Urban bus lines in Valladolid, Spain; avoid Valladolid Mexico confusion.
November climate averages for Seville; forecast data is not the same intent.

queries.criteria: National archaeological museum free-entry conditions; official visitor information preferred.
A current Swift language release source, with dated/version evidence.
Official Apple security updates applicable near evaluation date, not generic news only.

Methodological limitations of small language model benchmarks.

Official AEMET OpenData API documentation and access requirements.
